verses.text: For the choir director; with stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. God be gracious to us and bless us, [And] cause His face to shine upon us-- Selah.
verses.textZh: （一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）願神憐憫我們，賜福與我們，用臉光照我們，（細拉）

verses.text: That Your way may be known on the earth, Your salvation among all nations.
verses.textZh: 好叫世界得知你的道路，萬國得知你的救恩。

verses.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.
verses.textZh: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！

verses.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For You will judge the peoples with uprightness And guide the nations on the earth. Selah.
verses.textZh: 願萬國都快樂歡呼；因為你必按公正審判萬民，引導世上的萬國。（細拉）

verses.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.
verses.textZh: 神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！

verses.text: The earth has yielded its produce; God, our God, blesses us.
verses.textZh: 地已經出了土產；神─就是我們的　神要賜福與我們。

verses.text: God blesses us, That all the ends of the earth may fear Him.
verses.textZh: 神要賜福與我們；地的四極都要敬畏他！
